name: allow-notify-on-incapable-host
narrows: Headless refusal gate weakened to admit exactly one member of its reject class: the incapable-host refusal is removed while the one-shot-lifetime refusal stays. Schema advertisement is untouched (still gated), only the execution-time refusal is dropped.
note: Expected collateral: core unified_exec refusal tests (notify_on_exit_refused_before_execution_on_unavailable_host) will also fail. The named app-server test must fail at the refusal-text assertions (tool result becomes an armed ack instead).

name: always-subscribe
narrows: Opt-in gate weakened to admit exactly one member of its non-subscribed class: default (non-opted) launches reserve and arm receipts like opted-in launches. Refusals (one-shot, incapable host, capacity) and inline-settle paths unchanged.
note: Expected collateral: core tests asserting default launches never touch receipt state may also fail. The named app-server test must fail waiting for the prompt continuation (timeout: the unopted server now gates) or at the no-receipt-ack assertion, whichever trips first.
